name: Rug Pull Setup
setup: Positive GEX (yellow) node stacked directly above a negative GEX (purple/Barney) node, with no obvious floor below. The positive node acts as a temporary ceiling; the underlying negative node is pro-cyclical — if price breaks below, dealer selling accelerates the flush.
entry: Short when price rejects the yellow ceiling node. Limit sell into the green candle pop. Target: the negative node below. If price breaks the purple node, hold — no floor means 'air pocket' free-fall mode.
exit: Cover at the next significant node below, or if price enters a void zone (no nodes), ride until a floor appears. Use ±5 point (SPX) / ±$0.50 (SPY) overshoot margin before declaring the level broken.
probability: High conviction when Trinity (SPX/SPY/QQQ) all show same yellow-over-purple config.
key_rules: Pro-cyclicality: purple nodes accelerate moves (selling begets more selling)
Air Pockets: no nodes below = free-fall, no support to catch price
VEX Override: during VIX spikes, VEX overrides GEX — distant nodes become magnetic
Node growth during break = real breakdown, not fakeout
edge_cases: If the purple node's value DECREASES during the break, it may be a liquidity hunt (fakeout)
VEX can override GEX during high-vol events — check VIX regime
